issuer: the Road Transport Administration Department (RTAD), Ministry of Transport and Communications
note: Read 2026-10-31 in archive.org's snapshots of the RTAD's own pages (rtad.gov.mm gave no answer to this egress); the snapshots are of September and October 2024, the latest the archive serves. Licence types and terms (20 September 2024): the “ခ” licence is for motorcycles, private vehicles carrying up to three tons and private vehicles carrying up to 15 people, for five years. Requirements (20 September 2024): an applicant for the “ခ” licence must be 18 full years and hold a learner's (“သ”) or another named licence valid at least three months, attend the traffic course or hold a driving school's certificate, and pass the tests. Fees (13 October 2024): the “ခ” licence, five years, 50,000 kyats new; the driving test (2,000 kyats each time) and the third-party insurance premium are charged apart. The snapshots are from 2024; no later text was reached.
